newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says growth forecasts achievable.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says growth forecasts achievable.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the government's forecast for economic growth in the coming year were eminently achievable and that he did not see any downside risk.

Asked if the economy was on target for four percent growth, Costello said: "In the budget we targetted growth in the forthcoming year of a little under four percent; you would see with this conjunction of figures that the forecasts we have put out there are eminently achievable."
"We don't see a downside risk on them," he said.
In its 1997/98 budget announced in May, the government forecast GDP growth of 3.75 percent for the financial year to end-June 1998.
